rationale: Slag impaled thigh (puncture) and burned leg: two natures in different groups -> multiple code. Slag both burned and impaled; Event 533 precedes 642 in order of precedence, 6422 is a defensible alternative. Slag = molten metal.
'Muscle injury' without body part; heat plus exertion with no location. Event 53x precedes 7x in precedence; indoor/outdoor not stated. Body part not stated.
Hernia ruptured by contact with dishwasher at pelvic area. Contact with stationary dishwasher; walking vs. bumping not stated.
Snake bite, species/venom not stated; event guidance sends unspecified bites without systemic reaction to Nature 167. Back of knee = knee.
Fractured knee but no mechanism stated (no slip, trip, fall or contact described). Event and source cannot be assigned.
Tire exploded while being inflated; Event 6422 excludes tires/rims that exploded -> 313. Source = pressurized tire.

Surgical amputation after hyperextension while rising from floor. Initial injury type not described; amputation is the stated outcome. Rule 4(e)(2) (sequelae) argues for the initial injury but it is not specified.
Slip on rain-water puddle on floor; head injury unspecified. Surface = constructed floor; item slipped on = non-chemical liquid (wet floor).
Worker on foot run over by forklift: pedestrian event in nonroadway area (253); 655 is excluded for pedestrian incidents. Direction of travel not stated.

Fingertip amputated by shifting load of metal parts being moved by hand; event could be handled-object, shifting-object or caught-between. Source is a metal repair part (no specific code in narrative).
Chemical burns from caustic soda beads (Source 1461 lye/alkali hydroxides); skin contact = exposure through intact tissue. Burn degree not stated. Face plus ear = multiple ear/facial.
Pyrotechnics misfired/blasted; injury type to hands not stated (no burn or fracture described). Explosion; source = fireworks.

Hand entangled in paper-machine rollers but injury described is burns from hot steam-heated roller. Entanglement initiated the chain; contact with hot roller produced the burn; 533 precedes 653 in order of precedence; 653 is a defensible alternative. Forearm burned.

Roll dropped from clamp onto arm causing compartment syndrome with blood clots. Crush injury (103); alternatively vascular injury. Hand-to-bicep = hand and arm. Struck by falling object; source = roll, secondary = equipment it fell from.
Head injury with bleeding/clots, facial trauma, fractures, laceration: spans groups 11, 12, 13 -> multiple traumatic code 181x. Falling branch while cutting trees.
Pipe rolled over leg: fracture plus compartment syndrome. Struck by rolling/shifting non-running object. Pipe was on a trailer.
Fall from ladder, height not stated; 'back and leg injuries' with no injury type. Source ladder type not stated.

Industrial vehicle hit dirt patch and struck a light post. Injuries: stitches (laceration) plus hip surgery (type not stated) - nature cannot be pinned down; two injured workers described in one record.
Central cord syndrome = spinal cord injury (n.e.c.). Fall on same level after losing footing; slip vs loss of balance not clear; cause of slip not stated.
Thumb amputation plus palm laceration from running table saw; amputation is the more severe injury. Thumb + palm = hand and finger.
Tripped over a curb and fell: Event 42 includes 'tripping or falling over curbs'. Fracture plus laceration -> 1823. Wrist + forehead = head and extremities.
Mower blade struck foot; no injury type stated. Struck by running powered equipment; mower type not stated.
Forklift struck a rack and thumb partially amputated; mechanism for the thumb injury not described (caught between? struck by?). Vehicle collision coded; limited by narrative.
Slipped on ice descending stairs and fell to the ground. Fall to lower level (stairs): Source = stairs; Secondary = ice. Sprain severity not stated.
Punched in the head by a client; brain injury unspecified. Whether the worker was providing care not stated.
10-ft fall from step ladder shaken by a co-worker; 'shoulder and head injuries' gives no injury type. Fall 6-30 ft; co-worker is the item that caused the fall.
Roller attached to a lifted panel fell about 2 ft onto head and struck shoulder/back; contusion. Source part (roller) and panel are not specifically named equipment.
Face contact with hexavalent chromium bath followed by facial swelling; skin reaction. Injury type (burn vs dermatitis) not stated. Chromium is listed under 1429.
Eye injury while installing rebar; no mechanism or object described (flying particle? contact?). Event and source cannot be assigned.
Acute asthma exacerbation after single-episode exposure to disinfectant cleaner while cleaning operating rooms. Pre-existing asthma implied by 'exacerbation' (Nature Rule 4b: secondary source 561*).
Arm pulled between roller and casting drum; injury was a friction burn. Nature 133 includes friction burns. Entangled in running equipment during normal operation (threading film).
Fall of about 20-25 ft when a utility pole split; brain bleed/concussion plus fractures -> multiple traumatic code. Collapsing equipment/structure fall 6-30 ft.
Smoke inhalation from fire involving a vacuum pump in a basement: Nature 161 covers smoke inhalation with no further information; fire involving machinery.
Head struck baler door while straightening up; back injury described as pinched nerve plus bulging disc (2723 includes bulging disc and pinched nerve from herniated disc).
Tire side wall ruptured under inflation (pressure vessel/tire explosion). Rib fractures with punctured lung = 1232 (includes rib fractures with internal chest injuries).
Slip and fall on floor while cleaning; dislocated right shoulder.
Multiple wasp/bee stings with anaphylaxis: Nature 162; systemic reaction -> Part 6 (body systems).

Foot slipped while standing on equipment clearing a jam; 'severe laceration' with no body part, no statement of what caused the cut (machine contact? fall?). Event, source and part cannot be determined.
Dryer fell out of trailer onto head; neck pain, slurred speech, light sensitivity but no diagnosis. Falling object; source = dryer, secondary = trailer.
Fell about 4 ft from ladder after losing grip on a pipe wrench; scratches to face plus compressed discs (spine). Fall <6 ft. Ladder type not stated.
Piston in machine pressed into back of right hand while clearing stuck products: contact with running equipment during non-normal operation (unjamming).
Contact with garbage liquid or caustic fluid causing forearm burns; the substance is uncertain ('garbage juice or a caustic fluid') so nature and source are uncertain.
Shock then fall from ladder: combination event code 412*; fractures/dislocation plus electrical burns span groups. Height of fall not stated; wire stripper contacted live wire.
Pipe rolled off support, struck A-frame ladder and worker fell 7.5 ft: fall resulting from contact. Contusion plus lacerations -> 138; body parts not stated.
Hand pulled into unguarded triangle roller: fractured fingers plus degloving (avulsion). Glove caught (PPE) and unguarded machine as secondary source candidates.
Stabbed in abdomen with a knife; one wound punctured lung; surgery to remove knife fragment. Open wounds involving internal organs. Assailant relationship not stated.
Copperhead (venomous) bite; hospitalized; no description of site or symptoms.
Hand contacted blade while removing stuck fish from machine (unjamming); cut ligaments between thumb and index finger. Machine running state not stated.
Shot in abdomen by client's adult son: Event 111; source = person who inflicted the injury, secondary = firearm.
Slipped and fell through ladder access hatch to deck below on cargo ship; fall height not stated.
Arm trapped in conveyor tripper while cleaning running conveyor with scraper: fractures plus friction burns (133 includes friction burns). Wrists plus thigh span upper and lower extremities.
Worker tripped and dropped the concrete rip rap himself, crushing fingers: object dropped by the injured worker (secondary source 991 per 6431 guidance).
Heat exhaustion/dehydration while loading pipe and hose; indoor/outdoor not stated so duration/location code unspecified.
Strain of left wrist lifting toolbox onto cart; overexertion lifting object by hand; container (toolbox) coded over contents.

Capped pressurized line cut; cap blew off, hit saw into face; metal fragments in eyes, lacerations, contusions -> multiple surface/flesh wounds. Explosion vs propelled/dislodged object is a rule judgment (313 EXC points to 642).
Worker on foot tripped into path of forklift and arm and legs were pinned and crushed. Pedestrian-vehicle event (25*) precedes fall in order of precedence; injury type 'pinned and crushed' only.
Hernia while lifting boxes from conveyor into truck; hernia location not specified.
Metal propelled into right eye from pneumatic stapler: event 6421 includes nail/staple gun discharge. Source = staple, secondary = stapler.
Physically assaulted: brain bleed, orbital fracture and scalp laceration plus hand, hip and back injuries. Relationship of the carpenter to the worker unclear (work associate vs unknown).

Unwitnessed: worker found unconscious with wheelchair on top of her. Skull fracture behind ear with subarachnoid hemorrhage -> 1111. Mechanism (fall? tip-over? struck?) is not described, so event and source cannot be assigned.
Herniated disc while moving boxes; region of back not stated.
Caught between customer's trailer (pulling forward) and forklift: fractured and dislocated ribs. Vehicle in motion vs nonrunning objects and pedestrian rules all plausible.
Hand entered machine while troubleshooting; blade contacted finger; fingertip amputation. Machine type not named.
Rotating pump shaft inside a batter machine fractured two fingers while sanitizing (cleaning during operation).
Shot in back of neck, paralyzed: Nature 121 excludes paralysis from gunshot (112). Quadriplegia/paralysis from neck -> Part 21. Shooter's relationship unknown.
Electric shock from lighting ballast then fall from 6-ft ladder: combination event 412*; dislocated shoulder plus electrical effects.
Patient became aggressive; patient and guard fell on the worker, fracturing tibia. Violence vs unintentional contact is not clear.
Multiple ant bites with difficulty breathing and hospitalization for allergic reaction (systemic) -> 162/16*; welts on lower legs noted.
Shotgun discharged accidentally while adjusting stock; gunshot wound to right big toe.
Hose caught in glue-machine rollers pulling arm in during rinsing/cleaning: contusions plus sprain/strain/tendon damage across forearm, elbow, upper arm.
Legionella-positive coolant of a lathe; severe respiratory symptoms; no diagnosis stated, 3197 includes Legionella. Exposure duration not stated.
Gasoline generator ignited during refueling; burns to arms, hands, neck, face. Fire vs flash fire vs explosion not stated; item that ignited unclear.
Arm tripped a sensor while worker cleaned conveyor; belts closed on arm; 'nerve damage' only. Cleaning (non-normal operation).
Assistant to welder burned on hands, neck, face; mechanism not described (spatter? arc?), degree 1st-2nd -> highest degree coded.
Truck air spring exploded and propelled head into truck frame: head and hearing injuries not specified further.
Panel from another crate broke loose from its screws and struck hip: dislodged/detached object; dislocated hip.

Walk-behind mower hit rock and stopped; worker thrown against control bar; large-intestine injury. Closed trauma to internal organ; event is a judgment (irregular movement of running equipment vs struck against).
Shock while plugging in panel strings: electrical burns to hands. Voltage not stated; equipment (solar array lead assembly) mapped to electric parts.

Shifting pallets pinned worker against machine part: broken ribs and liver laceration -> closed trauma to internal organs; ribs plus abdomen = multiple trunk. Whether the machine was running not stated.
Hot fryer oil melted through plastic bucket and spilled on legs and feet; first- and second-degree burns (highest degree coded). Hot-oil splash is contact with hot substance (Event 326 excludes).
Conveyor contacted hand while grabbing a tray: abrasion. Conveyor type not stated.
Lifeline broke while descending light pole, fall about 22 ft; fractured arm plus punctured lung. Equipment failure during fall.
Vehicle came through barriers and struck worker manning a water pump; 'head trauma' only; roadway vs non-roadway location not stated.
Load-handling device unexpectedly moved while worker troubleshot a sensor; head injury, aspiration-induced lung injury and fractures -> multiple traumatic injuries.
Fell into hot water tank while removing railing: knee burns. Fall resulting in exposure/contact; height not stated.
Tractor backed into dead tree; limb fell and struck head: vehicle struck by falling object, nonroadway. Facial lacerations plus unspecified head trauma.

Traffic truck (standing) struck from behind by a tractor trailer; worker on lift gate thrown to ground: concussion, head laceration, femur fracture. Occupant vs pedestrian classification is a judgment call.
Steam from food triggered respiratory and cardiac arrest from food allergy: anaphylaxis; route (inhalation of allergen in steam) inferred from text.
Small boat swamped, passengers fell into cold river; hypothermia. Water vehicle capsized/sinking (non-collision); vehicle type not stated.
Slipped on truck steps and fell; head contusion. Event 42 includes slips while boarding/alighting vehicles. Body part limited to 'head'.
Worker bending over was struck by a forklift as it began to move, fell onto pallet; contusion of unspecified site.
Heart attack after digging snow from tires and applying chains; relation to work activity is plausible but not established; event and source are low-confidence.
Tripped over a board secured to dock floor; knee struck the dock: fall on same level due to trip; broken knee.
Lathe caught the worker's glove and pulled hand in: crushing injuries of hand and finger; lathe source, glove as secondary (PPE).
Wrong chemical pumped into drum: reaction and combustion; first- and second-degree chemical burns to face, forearm, back, head. Fire vs explosion vs chemical exposure not clearly stated.
Stringer supporting a walkway in agricultural building broke; fall to ground level from second level; fractured ribs. Fall height not stated.
Fell while freeing a wedged saw blade; face laceration. Cannot tell whether the saw or the ground caused the cut, so event and source cannot be assigned.
Fell about 10 ft from roof, lost consciousness; concussion plus fracture near tailbone -> brain plus severe wound/fracture.
Tripped on loose soil and contacted open electrical cabinet: burns to hands/wrists and cardiopulmonary arrest. Fall resulting in contact vs direct electrical exposure.
Slipped on ladder and fell to ground; broken ribs and lacerated spleen -> closed trauma to internal organs. Height and ladder type not stated.
